Corporal Thund Splithoof appears on the other side of the road from the Fallen Hero of the Horde, just several steps away.  If you don't see him, talk to the Fallen Hero of the Horde again -- there should be an option to tell the Fallen Hero that you have urgent business with Corporal Thund Splithoof, which will cause the Corporal to reappear.
replies: there is no option with the fallen hero to reappear the corporal
